title: 第3211章 这是强者恒强啊水脏阴雷三阶圆满小世界九阶圆满第3210章 融烽尊者也跑了阴雷闪对神隐雷瞬身的改造
content_zh:
只听一声嗡鸣，炮弹化作抛物线，在众人的期望下，向着鬼子的机枪阵地射过去。
随着几道身影从草丛钻了出来，看着眼前的一幕，几个士兵对视一眼，露出笑容。
严明逃了一日的课，犹在导员早经如提早打过呼叫了，否则严明的艰难还真有点大了。
这回连孙志伟也没举措了，住户谢永强都发话了，你一只班长还能咋呼甚么！
你无非是导员的一只发言人已矣。
周卫国闻声点了点头，这次他准备带着a排做件大事，一旦成功将会彻底改变整个战局走向。
数不清的记者张牙舞爪，接机的粉丝密密麻麻，韩试走出机场通道的瞬间，被眼前的大阵势吓了一跳，差点直接把脚步缩回去了。
绿色的能量覆盖在了张北的身上，一阵阵温暖从全身游走了起来。
于是伍巡抚找到了古万长，两人都深知事情的紧迫性和严重性，一番协商后，山东境内轰轰烈烈的剿匪运动就展开了。
玄龟只是淡淡的看了眼张北手中的令牌，身体再度嵌入到了海水中。
以往的那些继承人，包括他的父亲，都是经历了十年之久的努力。
魔神真的会出现吗？陆天雨等得有些不耐烦了，看向旁边的人。
左边是杜马，右边是皇家学院的队长裘里。
同时咔的一声，便深深的镶嵌到在后方，一只正在移动的钢甲生化幽灵头颅之中。
“我会帮你找秘卷，但我现在要见他，确保他平安无事。”
花连锁透过视频看着魔神的脸，恨不得一剑劈了他，自一个月前魔神以陆天雨生命相要挟，她已经在这个荒凉的世界，寻觅了一个多月。
气泡不断涌出，化龙池内升起一团氤氲，徐徐将云天扬身形笼罩。
化龙池的力量，不断聚涌，朝向云天扬体内蔓延而去，将皮肤、肌肉、骨骼、经脉，甚至内脏，都覆盖包裹起来。
通过他刚刚的这一番解释，苏彻非但没有听懂，反而更糊涂了。
当然，这不是最重要的，此刻对苏彻来说，先把家人救出来，才是首要之事。

“放心，老夫还在等着回去看儿子呢，想死？你也要问问老天爷收不收我！”
贾岩脸上露出不屑的嘲讽神色，走到基地顶端的边缘位置，望着头顶上距离的乌云，还有那低声轰鸣的雷声，丝毫不为所动。
王昙不以为然地撇撇嘴，“我才不信呢!”
她也故意回避李恪粘在她身边的事。
站在远处的斯沃特等人，听闻着从二代母体口中发出撕心裂肺般的嘶吼声，都是忍不住震惊了一下。
比如，因为他被天道摒弃的原因，他的运气必然是负数的，或许喝口水，都会呛死？
content_en:
Just a buzzing sound was heard, and the artillery shell turned into a parabola. Under everyone's expectations, it shot towards the Japanese machine gun position.
As several figures emerged from the grass, looking at the scene in front of them, several soldiers looked at each other and smiled.
Yan Ming skipped class for a day, but the instructor had called Ru in advance, otherwise Yan Ming would have been in a lot of trouble.
This time even Sun Zhiwei didn't take any action, and resident Xie Yongqiang even spoke out. What else can you say as a squad leader!
You are nothing more than a spokesperson for the instructor.
Zhou Weiguo nodded upon hearing this. This time he was planning to take Platoon A to do something big. Once successful, it would completely change the direction of the entire war.
Countless reporters were arrogant, and fans were gathering at the airport. The moment Han Shi walked out of the airport passage, he was startled by the huge formation in front of him, and almost retracted his steps.
Green energy covered Zhang Bei's body, and waves of warmth swam from his body.
So Governor Wu found Gu Wanchang. Both of them were well aware of the urgency and seriousness of the matter. After some negotiations, a vigorous anti-bandit campaign in Shandong was launched.
Xuangui just glanced at the token in Zhang Bei's hand, and his body was embedded in the sea water again.
The previous heirs, including his father, had worked hard for ten years.
Will the devil really appear? Lu Tianyu became a little impatient and looked at the person next to him.
On the left is Duma, on the right is Juri, the captain of the Royal Academy.
At the same time, with a click, it was embedded deeply into the head of a moving steel-armored biochemical ghost behind.
"I will help you find the secret scroll, but I want to see him now to make sure he is okay."
Hua Lianlian looked at the Demon God's face through the video, wishing to strike him with a sword. Since the Demon God threatened Lu Tianyu's life a month ago, she had been searching for him in this desolate world for more than a month.
Bubbles continued to gush out, and a cloud of mist rose up in the Hualong Pond, slowly covering Yuntian Yang's figure.
The power of Hualong Pond continued to gather and spread toward Yuntianyang's body, covering the skin, muscles, bones, meridians, and even internal organs.
Through his explanation just now, Suche not only failed to understand, but became even more confused.
Of course, this is not the most important thing. For Suche at this moment, rescuing his family first is the first priority.
"Don't worry, I'm still waiting to go back to see my son. Do you want to die? You have to ask God if he will accept me!"
With a look of disdain and ridicule on his face, Jia Yan walked to the edge of the top of the base, looking at the dark clouds in the distance above his head and the low roar of thunder, unmoved at all.
Wang Tan curled his lips in disapproval, "I don't believe it!"
She also deliberately avoided Li Ke sticking around her.
Swart and others standing in the distance couldn't help but be shocked when they heard the heart-rending roar coming from the mouth of the second-generation mother.
For example, because he was abandoned by Heaven, his luck must be negative. Maybe he would choke to death if he drank water?
